# An image shows its source, and follows what the source reads.
#
# The drawing reads `r`, so the click that grows it repaints the picture the
# image shows -- an offscreen raster handed to the image widget on fyne, a
# cairo surface made a texture on gtk4, a data URL on html. The avatar's
# source sits under `if shown`: before the click its source is empty and it
# shows its fallback, the initials, and after it the file the program carries. So the two
# snapshots of each target differ, and the interpreter's tree says why. The
# file is a PNG written at the start, which every target can read: a GTK host
# with no pixbuf loader modules has none for SVG.

exec sh -c 'echo iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAABAAAAAQCAIAAACQkWg2AAAAGElEQVR4nGL5z0AaYIIxRjWMahh+GgADAEleASJ7ejoXAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC | base64 -d > logo.png'
mkdir gtk4 fyne html none
cp app.sngl gtk4/app.sngl
cp logo.png gtk4/logo.png
env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=gtk4 gtk4/app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'
! cmp gtk4/app.sngl.snapshots/before.png gtk4/app.sngl.snapshots/after.png

cp app.sngl fyne/app.sngl
cp logo.png fyne/logo.png
sngl test --platform=fyne fyne/app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'
! cmp fyne/app.sngl.snapshots/before.png fyne/app.sngl.snapshots/after.png

cp app.sngl html/app.sngl
cp logo.png html/logo.png
sngl test --platform=html html/app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'
grep 'src="data:image/png' html/app.sngl.snapshots/before.html
grep 'aria-label="dot"' html/app.sngl.snapshots/before.html
grep '>JD<' html/app.sngl.snapshots/before.html
! grep '>JD<' html/app.sngl.snapshots/after.html
grep 'src="/assets/logo' html/app.sngl.snapshots/after.html
! cmp html/app.sngl.snapshots/before.html html/app.sngl.snapshots/after.html

cp app.sngl none/app.sngl
cp logo.png none/logo.png
sngl test --platform=none none/app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
grep 'circle\(cx=20, cy=20, r=3' none/app.sngl.snapshots/before.sngl
grep 'value="JD"' none/app.sngl.snapshots/before.sngl
grep 'circle\(cx=20, cy=20, r=13' none/app.sngl.snapshots/after.sngl
! grep 'value="JD"' none/app.sngl.snapshots/after.sngl
grep 'file\(' none/app.sngl.snapshots/after.sngl

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import draw "sngl:ui/draw"
import test "sngl:test"
import here "file:."

component main ui.node {
    var r = 3.0
    var shown = false
    ui.vbox {
        ui.image(alt="dot") {
            draw.image(width=40.0, height=40.0) {
                draw.circle(cx=20.0, cy=20.0, r=r, style={fill=#3366CC})
            }
        }
        ui.avatar(initials="JD", size=large) {
            component src {
                if shown {
                    ui.file(path=here.path("logo.png"))
                }
            }
        }
        ui.button #grow(text="grow", @click {
            r = r + 10.0
            shown = true
        })
    }
}

func testRepaints(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.snapshot("before")
    c.grow.click()
    t.snapshot("after")
}

ui.window {
    main
}
